_comment: Attribution registry: every external website or service whose data, content, images or functionality the production website uses. The footer's 'Data & resource credits' is built from this list (texts in the locale files under credits.<id>), and website/tests check that each entry is rendered with its link on every page, in every language and theme. Software licences of the desktop program are a different matter: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.

providers.name: TibiaData
providers.uses: Public REST API (v5, https://api.tibiadata.com/v5/) for characters, worlds, guilds, highscores, houses, kill statistics, creatures, spells, boostable bosses, fansites and news, requested directly by the visitor's browser.
providers.attribution: Visible thank-you with a link in the footer of every page; 'Data: TibiaData' with a link on every data view.
providers.terms: Public API without key or rate limit in production (https://tibiadata.com/faq/); responses are cached by TibiaData for 1-15 minutes, our cache is never shorter. TibiaData's own data is based on tibia.com. No partnership or endorsement is implied.
where: home page: Tibia News & Updates, boosted creature and boss

providers.name: Tibia.com
providers.uses: Original source of the game information TibiaData provides: news articles (headlines, text and their images on static.tibia.com), character, guild and house data, creature, boss, spell, house and guild images loaded from static.tibia.com; every data view links to the original page on tibia.com.
providers.attribution: Footer credit with a link; 'Original on Tibia.com' links next to the data.
providers.terms: Tibia, its content, graphics and data are © CipSoft GmbH. Images are shown from CipSoft's own server (not copied). No affiliation with or endorsement by CipSoft GmbH.

providers.name: CipSoft GmbH
providers.uses: Rights holder of Tibia: game graphics in the program screenshots and pixel-art samples, and all game data shown on the site.
providers.attribution: Copyright notice and link in the footer.
providers.terms: Trademark and copyright notice; Tibia Foundry is an independent fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by CipSoft GmbH.

providers.name: TibiaWiki
providers.uses: Linked as the wiki the program works for; its template names ({{Infobox Object}}) and conventions are described. No TibiaWiki content is copied onto the site.
providers.terms: TibiaWiki content is licensed CC BY-SA by its authors on Fandom; none is reproduced here. No affiliation with Fandom.

providers.name: Tibia fansites
providers.uses: The fansite directory lists the promoted and supported fansites with their names, logos (from static.tibia.com) and links, as published on tibia.com through TibiaData.
providers.attribution: Each fansite is named and linked in the directory; the footer credits the fansite programme page.
providers.terms: Independent websites; listing does not imply any relationship with Tibia Foundry.
